subject: [PATCH v2 3/4] mm: workingset: skip the root memcg flush in workingset_test_recent()

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the workingset_test_recent() function to skip flushing the root memory cgroup's statistics when it is not necessary. The function now checks if the eviction memory cgroup is the root cgroup before deciding whether to flush its statistics. This optimization reduces the time taken for a root flush from 69us on an 80-CPU machine with little activity, and 0.9ms with high activity, down to negligible time. The patch also notes that flushing is still necessary for reclaim operations, but this change improves performance on systems with many memory cgroups.
